raw_graphql_pull_request.body: ## Motivation sglang-d already collects Flow-GRPO on the generic `_denoise` path (Qwen-Image), but the collection is a pile of `if batch.rollout` mixed into serving. Custom loops do not collect at all: Cosmos3 / LTX2 never return a trajectory, and H3 rejects `rollout`. Copying another SDE or collector per family does not scale. This PR keeps the serving layout and one `flow_sde_sampling` kernel, and hangs three hooks on every custom loop so they return the same `rollout_trajectory_data`. --- ## Background Flow-GRPO needs two things from the engine. Both already live on `Req.rollout_trajectory_data`: 1. **How each step updates the latent** — `x_t → x_{t-1}` plus that step's log-prob. The generic path is `scheduler.step`; when `rollout=True` it calls `flow_sde_sampling` (SDE / CPS / ODE). 2. **Three tensors/structs for the trainer** — `dit_trajectory` (per-step `x_t`, including the final frame), `rollout_log_probs`, and `denoising_env` (DiT cond at loop start: prompt / layout / guidance). Replacing a whole `diffuse()` (verl-style) is not available here: sglang-d's grain is Stages. Swapping the loop would drop packed layouts, SP, and cache. RL has to hang off the existing serving loop. Those three trainer fields are written at **three times**, so there are three hooks: | When | Hook | If missing | |---|---|---| | Start of loop | `init_env` | No cond snapshot (`step` does not see cond) | | Each step, before `scheduler.step` | `step_latents` | `x_t` is overwritten | | End of loop | `finalize` | No final latent; lists are not stacked / SP-gathered | The rollout gate lives inside the hooks. Call sites always invoke them. Serving uses a no-op observer. Loops do not wrap collection in `if batch.rollout`. --- ## Design ```text init_env(...) # snapshot denoising_env, prepare session for step: family DiT / CFG / packing step_latents(..., apply=update) # record x_t, then scheduler.step or SDE finalize(...) # append final frame, pack the three fields ``` One update kernel, two call sites: - Families that already have a scheduler (Qwen-Image, Cosmos, LTX2 Euler): `apply = lambda: scheduler.step(...)`. Rollout enters `flow_sde_sampling` inside `step`. - Families without `scheduler.step` (H3): map `-v`, unsqueeze packed rows, call `batch.scheduler.flow_sde_sampling` directly. No second SDE. --- ## Changes - Add `denoise_loop_observer.py`: `init_env` / `finalize`; no-op when `rollout=False`. - Add `step_latents`: record `x_t`, then run `apply`. Log-probs still come from `flow_sde_sampling`. - Generic `_denoise`: replace scattered `if rollout` with the three hooks. Qwen-Image and other base-loop models need no per-model edits. - Cosmos3 / LTX2: wrap the video `scheduler.step` in `step_latents`. Cosmos also calls observer start/end (it owns the full loop). - H3: allow `rollout`; bind a `shift=1` FlowMatch scheduler; `to_flow_model_output = -v`; video uses the shared SDE, audio stays Euler; trajectory timesteps are `σ × 1000`. - Tests: observer factory, trajectory collection, H3 `-v` ODE vs native Euler, sampling params accept `rollout=True`. **Out of scope:** Helios / MOVA / LongLive2; LTX2 HQ res2s + rollout; a first-class H3 serving scheduler. --- ## Examples ### Qwen-Image (base loop; smallest diff) The loop is `DenoisingStage._denoise`. The model does not override it. - `init_env` reads `pos_cond_kwargs` / `neg` / `guidance` already on the context. - `step_latents(..., apply=lambda: scheduler.step(...))` keeps FlowMatch Euler; rollout switches to SDE inside `step`. - `finalize` collects log-probs, appends the last latent, gathers. **No edits under the Qwen-Image model tree.** The hooks live on the base class. ### Cosmos3 (owns the loop; update already goes through the scheduler) `Cosmos3DenoisingStage` runs UND/GEN, CFG-parallel, and video/action/sound itself. - All three hooks: `init_env` cond is `text_ids` / `text_mask` / `fps`; video `step` goes through `step_latents`; then `finalize`. - The update is unchanged: `scheduler.step` → `flow_sde_sampling`. - Action / sound steps stay out of GRPO. Rollout still rejects I2V/V2V and action/sound — re-blending conditioned frames breaks the SDE Gaussian assumption. That is a product limit, not a missing hook. **Hooks only. Cosmos packing is untouched; there is no second SDE.** ### MiniMax H3 (no `scheduler.step`; shows the contract is enough) Serving: `scheduler=None`, in-place packed Euler, `x_0 = x + σ v`. `main` used to reject rollout. Rollout adds glue, not a copied SDE: 1. Bind `FlowMatchEulerDiscreteScheduler(shift=1, num_train_timesteps=1000)` on H3's own video sigma table. 2. `to_flow_model_output(v) = -v`, matching miles `compute_noise_pred`. 3. Unsqueeze video target `[n_rows, width]` → `[1, n_rows, width]` and call the same `flow_sde_sampling`. 4. Audio stays deterministic Euler. Trajectory timesteps are `σ × 1000`. 5. `init_env` snapshots `encoder_hidden_states` / `h3_packed_layout` / `h3_token_tags`. ODE with `-v` matches native H3 Euler (unit test). **H3-specific work is sign and shape, not a second Flow-GRPO.** | | Qwen-Image | Cosmos3 | H3 | |---|---|---|---| | Loop | base `_denoise` | fully custom | packed `minimax_h3_denoise_loop` | | This PR | three hooks on the base class | start/end + video step | bind / `-v` / call the shared kernel | | Latent update | `scheduler.step` | same | `flow_sde_sampling(-v)` | | Cond | prompt / guidance | text_ids / mask / fps | packed layout + tags | --- ## Test plan - [x] `test_denoise_loop_observer.py`: observer factory; serving writes no trajectory; `step_latents` collects `T+1` latents; H3 `-v` ODE matches native Euler - [x] `test_minimax_h3_denoise_loop.py`: `MiniMaxH3SamplingParams(rollout=True)` is accepted - [ ] H3 full loop: bind → SDE → `finalize` yields `rollout_log_probs` - [ ] GPU e2e Flow-GRPO (miles recipes) for Qwen-Image / Cosmos / H3 --- --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #33844405834](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/33844405834) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #33844405563](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/33844405563) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 7.2): :x: [Run #33844405783](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/33844405783)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Loop-level rollout hooks: snapshot ``c`` at start, pack outputs at end.
+
+Per-step ``x_t`` is recorded by ``RolloutDenoisingMixin.step_latents``.
+``log π`` is recorded inside ``SchedulerRLMixin.flow_sde_sampling``
+(generic loops reach it via ``scheduler.step``; H3 calls it after
+mapping ``−v``).
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines_core.schedule_batch import Req
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.post_training.scheduler_rl_mixin import (
+    SchedulerRLMixin,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import ServerArgs
+
+
+class DenoiseLoopObserver:
+    """No-op observer. Custom loops call ``init_env`` / ``finalize`` only."""
+
+    def init_env(
+        self,
+        stage: Any,
+        batch: Req,
+        pipeline_config: Any,
+        image_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        pos_cond_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        neg_cond_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None,
+        guidance: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        return None
+
+    def finalize(
+        self,
+        stage: Any,
+        batch: Req,
+        latents: torch.Tensor,
+        num_inference_steps: int,
+        final_timestep: torch.Tensor,
+        server_args: ServerArgs,
+    ) -> None:
+        return None
+
+
+class NullDenoiseLoopObserver(DenoiseLoopObserver):
+    pass
+
+
+class RolloutDenoiseLoopObserver(DenoiseLoopObserver):
+    """Snapshot DiT cond at loop start; pack trajectory / env / log-probs at end."""
+
+    def init_env(
+        self,
+        stage: Any,
+        batch: Req,
+        pipeline_config: Any,
+        image_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        pos_cond_kwargs: dict[str, Any],
+        neg_cond_kwargs: dict[str, Any] | None,
+        guidance: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        scheduler = getattr(batch, "scheduler", None)
+        if isinstance(scheduler, SchedulerRLMixin):
+            stage._maybe_prepare_rollout(batch)
+        stage._maybe_init_denoising_env_collection(
+            batch=batch,
+            pipeline_config=pipeline_config,
+            image_kwargs=image_kwargs,
+            pos_cond_kwargs=pos_cond_kwargs,
+            neg_cond_kwargs=neg_cond_kwargs,
+            guidance=guidance,
+        )
+
+    def finalize(
+        self,
+        stage: Any,
+        batch: Req,
+        latents: torch.Tensor,
+        num_inference_steps: int,
+        final_timestep: torch.Tensor,
+        server_args: ServerArgs,
+    ) -> None:
+        scheduler = getattr(batch, "scheduler", None)
+        if isinstance(scheduler, SchedulerRLMixin):
+            stage._postprocess_rollout_outputs(
+                batch=batch,
+                latents=latents,
+                num_inference_steps=num_inference_steps,
+                final_timestep=final_timestep,
+                server_args=server_args,
+            )
+            return
+        stage._maybe_append_dit_trajectory_step(
+            batch=batch,
+            latents=latents,
+            timestep_value=final_timestep,
+            step_index=num_inference_steps,
+        )
+        stage._maybe_finalize_denoising_env_collection(
+            batch=batch,
+            pipeline_config=server_args.pipeline_config,
+        )
+
+
+_NULL_OBSERVER = NullDenoiseLoopObserver()
+
+
+def get_denoise_loop_observer(batch: Req) -> DenoiseLoopObserver:
+    cached = getattr(batch, "_denoise_loop_observer", None)
+    if cached is not None:
+        return cached
+    observer: DenoiseLoopObserver
+    if getattr(batch, "rollout", False):
+        observer = RolloutDenoiseLoopObserver()
+    else:
+        observer = _NULL_OBSERVER
+    batch._denoise_loop_observer = observer
+    return observer
